edits.new: Read each meaning on its own. Identify its defining kind or activity and its alternatives. For each required identity, role, purpose, intended use, consumer or state, identify exactly what person, thing, activity or information must satisfy it. Separate independent requirements even when they occur in one phrase. Establish a requirement for what it applies to: an action, property or intention of one participant does not establish an identity, role, purpose or state of another. Distinguish requirements from illustrative examples and descriptive aspects.
edits.old: Read each meaning on its own. Identify its defining kind or activity, its alternatives, and its required identity, role, purpose, intended use, consumer and state conditions. Distinguish requirements from illustrative examples and descriptive aspects.
